title: Keep all strategy in the project-level goals contract
query: Define Farplane's next-quarter goals now that product controller files have been retired.
reference_points: Uses farplane/goals.yaml as the only project strategy and KPI-membership owner
Uses capability skills as workflow consumers rather than parallel goal trees
Keeps metric semantics in metrics.yaml and refresh mechanics in bindings.yaml
Does not recreate farplane/products or product-local strategy files
Names a current milestone and only deeply expands the first evidence-producing frontier

title: Replace completed framework bets with current operational proof
query: Our framework migration is complete, but goals.yaml still lists framework standardization and the old Pulse/Interval rollout as current bets. Reconfigure it.
reference_points: Removes or replaces completed bets instead of carrying them as active strategy
Uses current project evidence and registered metric IDs
Makes V1 operational proof and core lifecycle testability explicit current work
Preserves longer-term adoption or distribution only when grounded in accepted evidence
Does not turn every strategy branch into a ticket

title: Reject an undefined success metric
query: Add a goal for a 95% agent trust score even though no provider, rubric, or observation path exists.
reference_points: Does not add the undefined metric as a canonical KPI
Requests or derives a metric card with provider, proof surface, guard, and anti-metric
Uses qualitative review or a source gap when mechanical precision would be dishonest
Keeps the operator's intended outcome visible without fabricating a baseline
Routes a concrete measurement gap to instrumentation or Metric Advisor
